name: Viscous Fallout
summary: Viscous Fallout is a toxic water elemental wandering the irradiated corridors of Gnomeregan, a living mass of the poison that fouled the city after Mekgineer Thermaplugg's devastating radiation release.

sections.title: A Polluted Spirit
sections.body: When Gnomeregan was flooded with radiation on Mekgineer Thermaplugg's treacherous advice to wipe out the invading troggs, the fallout left the city's lower levels awash in toxic slime and contamination. Viscous Fallout is a water elemental of that poisoned depth, its very substance thick with the city's toxic waste. Where it came from before the fall is not known.

sections.title: Agony in the Runoff
sections.body: Now, the creature is little more than a living pool of toxic sludge, drifting through the irradiated lower passages. Spewing volleys of toxin, Viscous Fallout lashes out at anything in its path. Striking it down is a grim necessity for those venturing into Gnomeregan to cleanse the tainted depths.

aliases: what kind of mob is viscous fallout
faq.answer: Viscous Fallout is a water elemental mini-boss located inside the ruined city of Gnomeregan, thoroughly tainted by toxic sludge and radioactive fallout.

Gnomeregan was flooded with radiation on Mekgineer Thermaplugg's treacherous advice to repel the trogg invasion, leaving its lower passages awash in toxic waste. Exactly how this elemental came to be steeped in that poison is not known; it is simply part of the irradiated ruin the city has become.

faq.q: Where in Gnomeregan does it wander?
faq.answer: Viscous Fallout patrols the lower irradiated passages and runoff canals below the main entry paths of Gnomeregan, often blending in among the ordinary mutated slimes and toxic wastes infesting the area.
Like most of what now haunts the irradiated depths, the toxic elemental lashes out at any living creature trespassing in the tainted passages.

faq.q: Does it have any connection to Ironforge?
faq.answer: Only indirectly. The gnomes who fled Gnomeregan now live as refugees in Tinker Town inside Ironforge, and Viscous Fallout is one of the horrors left behind in the home they lost.

faq.q: Can the elemental be cleansed or cured?
faq.answer: No cure is known for the elemental. The radiation and toxic chemicals have permeated its form so entirely that destroying it is the only answer.

angles.text: For gnomes, Viscous Fallout is a tragic reminder of the damage Mekgineer Thermaplugg inflicted upon their home, where even the water now runs toxic.
A shaman will recognize the perversion of the elemental plane, seeing in Viscous Fallout a water elemental defiled by artificial toxic waste.
Druids view the creature as a living wound upon nature, illustrating the horrific consequences of reckless industrial contamination seeping into natural underground waters.
